name: Neon Raymarcher
definition: A real-time WebGL2 raymarching renderer that generates an infinite procedural synthwave city using signed-distance fields (SDFs) in a single fullscreen fragment shader, requiring no meshes, textures, or scene graph.
summary: Neon Raymarcher is a WebGL2 renderer generating infinite procedural synthwave cities via SDFs, distinguished by a deterministic hashing contract ensuring visual and game logic consistency.
